compiled_state.description:
`_ci_and_repair` at `services/orchestration/temporal_workflows/draft_pull_request.py:861-919` evaluates the budget immediately after a repair is applied, then leaves the loop before the checks run again.

The sequence is that `_repair` applies a fix, `budget_reason = self._budget_breach(params, impl)` is computed, `repairs` advances when `repair.applied` is true, and `if budget_reason or not repair.applied: break` ends the loop. Control reaches the tail with `result` still holding the pre-repair run, so the workflow reports `CI_FAILED` for a state that the applied repair may already have corrected.

The run then ends on `return replace(result, repair_attempts=repairs, terminal_reason=budget_reason)`, which escalates to a human with a stale failure. The platform paid for the repair, wrote it to the branch, and discarded the evidence of whether it worked.

Stopping once the budget is spent is correct. Reporting an unvalidated status is not. A repair that has been applied should have its result observed before the run reports a terminal state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] An applied repair is verified by a further checks run before the budget ends the loop, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k applied_repair_is_verified_before_the_budget_terminates_the_run`
- [ ] A run whose final repair fixes the checks reports success rather than a stale failure, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k budget_breach_after_a_successful_repair_reports_the_repaired_status`
- [ ] A run whose final repair leaves the checks failing still reports the budget reason, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k budget_breach_after_a_failed_repair_still_reports_the_budget_reason`
- [ ] A budget breach on an unapplied repair ends the loop without a further checks run, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k budget_breach_without_an_applied_repair_runs_no_further_checks`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
compiled_state.title: Verify an applied repair before the budget ends the checks loop
